facts: JPEG XR is a still - image compression standard.
JPEG XR is a file format for continuous tone photographic images.
JPEG XR is based on technology originally developed by Microsoft.
The technology underlying JPEG XR was patented by Microsoft.
The technology underlying JPEG XR was under the name HD Photo.
HD Photo was formerly Windows Media Photo.
JPEG XR is the preferred image format for Ecma-388 Open XML Paper Specification documents.
Support for the JPEG XR format is available in Adobe Flash Player 11.0.
Support for the JPEG XR format is available in Adobe AIR 3.0.
Support for the JPEG XR format is available in Sumatra PDF 2.1.
JPEG XR is JPEG extended range.
Support for the JPEG XR format is available in Internet Explorer 11.
As of August 2014, there were still no cameras that shoot photos in the JPEG XR (.JXR) format.
